items.name: Label
items.summary: `name=value` pairs identifying a metric. This concept is called various things in various different systems:

methods.name: name
methods.summary: Returns the name of this label

methods.signature: fn new(name: impl Into<LabelValue>, value: impl Into<LabelValue>) -> Self

methods.name: value
methods.summary: Returns the value of this label

methods.summary: Return this label value as a string slice.

items.name: Metric
items.summary: Something that tracks a value of interest (metric) during execution.

methods.name: labels
methods.summary: What labels are present for this metric?

methods.name: metric_category
methods.summary: Return the metric category, if one was declared.

methods.name: metric_type
methods.summary: Return the metric type (verbosity level) associated with this metric

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(value: MetricValue, partition: Option<usize>) -> Self
methods.summary: Create a new [`Metric`]. Consider using [`MetricBuilder`] rather than this function directly.

methods.summary: Create a new [`Metric`]. Consider using [`MetricBuilder`] rather than this function directly.

methods.name: partition
methods.summary: Return a reference to the partition

methods.name: value
methods.summary: Return a reference to the value of this metric

methods.name: value_mut
methods.summary: Return a mutable reference to the value of this metric

methods.name: with_category
methods.summary: Set the semantic category for this metric.

methods.name: with_label
methods.summary: Add a new label to this metric

methods.name: with_type
methods.summary: Set the type for this metric. Defaults to [`MetricType::Dev`]

items.name: MetricsSet
items.summary: A snapshot of the metrics for a particular execution plan.

methods.name: aggregate_by_name
methods.summary: Returns a new derived `MetricsSet` where all metrics that had the same name have been aggregated together. The resulting `MetricsSet` has all metrics with `Partition=None`

methods.name: elapsed_compute
methods.summary: Convenience: return the amount of elapsed CPU time spent, aggregated across partitions or `None` if no metric is present

methods.name: extend
methods.signature: fn extend<I: IntoIterator<Item = Arc<Metric>>>(&mut self, iter: I)

methods.name: filter_by_categories
methods.summary: Returns a new `MetricsSet` filtered by [`MetricCategory`].

methods.name: filter_by_metric_types
methods.summary: Returns a new derived `MetricsSet` containing only metrics whose [`MetricType`] appears in `allowed`.

methods.name: filter_by_names
methods.summary: Returns a new `MetricsSet` filtered by metric name. Only metrics with the names appearing the list will be kept.

methods.name: fmt
methods.summary: Format the [`MetricsSet`] as a single string

methods.name: from_iter
methods.signature: fn from_iter<T: IntoIterator<Item = Arc<Metric>>>(iter: T) -> Self

methods.name: iter
methods.summary: Returns an iterator across all metrics

methods.name: new
methods.summary: Create a new container of metrics

methods.name: output_rows
methods.summary: Convenience: return the number of rows produced, aggregated across partitions or `None` if no metric is present

methods.name: push
methods.summary: Add the specified metric

methods.name: sorted_for_display
methods.summary: Sort the order of metrics so the "most useful" show up first

methods.name: spill_count
methods.summary: Convenience: return the count of spills, aggregated across partitions or `None` if no metric is present

methods.name: spilled_bytes
methods.summary: Convenience: return the total byte size of spills, aggregated across partitions or `None` if no metric is present

methods.name: spilled_rows
methods.summary: Convenience: return the total rows of spills, aggregated across partitions or `None` if no metric is present

methods.name: sum
methods.signature: fn sum<F>(&self, f: F) -> Option<MetricValue> where F: FnMut(&Metric) -> bool
methods.summary: Sums the values for metrics for which `f(metric)` returns `true`, and returns the value. Returns `None` if no metrics match the predicate.

methods.name: sum_by_name
methods.summary: Returns the sum of all the metrics with the specified name in the returned set.

methods.name: timestamps_removed
methods.summary: Remove all timestamp metrics (for more compact display)
